# Visualize: Direction Comps & Asset Production

Use this local procedure only when a visual comp or asset production resolves real uncertainty in the current authorized task. Reuse the accepted product/target context and selected direction. A code-backed/editable design path does not require comps. Local mode guidance is subordinate knowledge, not a second controller or runtime catalog.

A probe tests composition, narrative, hierarchy, density, focal moment, signature use, and image requirements. It is not a second identity workshop. Keep the world's palette, typography direction, material language, component character, imagery stance, and motion grammar fixed: accepted target design record's on an established world, the chosen direction's on a new one.

## Generate proportionate compositional options when useful

Use the actual available authorized image/design tool if the task needs comps. Keep outputs as explicitly proposed design artifacts with exact locators/revisions and source/prompt/license evidence. An already selected sufficient comp need not be regenerated. A small meaningful spread can compare topology, hierarchy, density, task/action placement and imagery; no fixed three-option rule or automatic subagent applies. Use the surface's actual platform/aspect and real content. A reference image, when available and permitted, carries accepted identity while the new surface's content/structure stays its own. A changed color or cosmetic variant alone is not a meaningful composition alternative.

- A comp prompt is short, 150 to 300 words, and carries only what the image model cannot know. The model draws what the prompt names and stops deciding whatever the prompt pins down, so a prompt that specifies everything gets back a template. Open with the surface: the kind of screen it is (a desktop web app, a documentation page, a landing page, a native app screen at its device viewport) for the product, by name, rendered edge to edge with crisp readable text and no browser window, device, or desk around it. Then the product and the visitor's job in plain words, with the real content that answers it: names, numbers with units, the offer or the state, any claim at its honest certainty, and the next action by name. Then what leads this comp, its product concept (summary-led, timeline-led, offer-led, reference-led), and the parts the screen holds in reading order, a phrase each. Then the frame in one line: the product's mark and name, its navigation, its utility controls, and the far edge, so the comp is a finished screen, never a fragment; a page with no navigation says so instead of inventing one. Leave sizes, positions, colours, and component styling out, except a colour, typeface, or brand element the user pinned: that is content, so state it. Self-check every render: if it could hang as a poster, or reads as a photograph with some text on it, it is not a comp; regenerate.
- The look follows the accepted world. Use an available permitted target/reference image when useful, naming what it contributes and what must not leak (its content or exact old composition). Without an image, describe a few concrete accepted visual roles. No foreign catalog image download or duplicate palette/workshop is required.
- The subject must be in it. Before accepting a render, point at the subject: a render that depicts the world and nothing of the subject fails however faithful its atmosphere, and the deletion usually rides in on an exclusion list. Regenerate with the subject's content named.
- Judge a comp as the shipped screen: the visitor's job must be readable from the image alone. Name the surface's mode from the render with no caption; a render whose mode cannot be read back is art direction without a surface. Regenerate with the visitor's job as the prompt's spine.
- Commitment is depth, not performance spread across regions. The world enters through one dominant move plus the material, type, and spacing that support it; the remaining regions hold still in that material and keep their content at real reading size. A second element competing with the lead at the same scale is the comp shouting: regenerate keeping the strongest move and quieting the rest. Busy is louder, not bolder.
- When several concepts remain shortlisted, compare the material unresolved structural differences at useful equivalent fidelity.
- When one direction is committed, vary the structural uncertainty an image can resolve: what leads the screen, topology, sequence, density, hierarchy, focal composition, or interaction framing.
- Show enough beyond the opening moment to prove the concept can govern the whole surface.
- Do not generate a palette artifact, ask new atmosphere questions, introduce a different type voice, or invent a new motif. If the committed world cannot support the concept, return to the concept shortlist rather than changing the world.

Each comp is a direction test, not a screenshot specification. Core UI text, responsive behavior, accessibility, semantics, and interaction states remain implementation responsibilities.

## One actual decision, at the current task's scope

Present useful alternatives with the host's actual supported mechanism. Ask only when the direction/composition is materially open and neither selected nor delegated. Reuse settled decisions. A generated image is a candidate, not actual runtime/UI evidence.

An unanswered or failed question remains pending; technical failures never delegate a choice or create approval. If the user already delegated selection, select from the real brief/evidence and record that delegated basis. When selection is explicit, bind its actual artifact locator/revision and the accepted commitments into the current brief; do not forge an approved flag or foreign receipt.

Continue only work already authorized by the task/selection. Keep product truth, semantics, accessible controls, actual text, platform behavior and responsive adaptation live. A new comp does not invent a new product fact or authorize an external effect.

## After approval: the comp becomes a spec

The approved comp is a north star for translation into semantic, responsive, accessible code, never a license to recompose: keeping the palette and mood while redrawing the topology is a second art direction. Do not rasterize core UI text or controls. Do not substitute a different visual driver after approval without asking.

Measure enough of the selected reference to retain actual salient topology, reading order, focal scale, lettering/material roles and meaningful interaction. Use the local region-map/translation procedure. A comp’s incidental words, decorative control or invented data is not accepted product truth. Keep core UI semantic and preserve actual responsive/accessibility needs; explain intentional adaptations from real constraints.

## Assets and provenance

Use licensed available target assets or a separately authorized production path. Keep the comp fixed. Reference crops help reproduce material but are not automatically shipping pixels. Separate independently changing images, frames and moving layers; inspect alpha/white foreground/fine edges on appropriate grounds when relevant.

Record the exact source/prompt, produced artifact revision, license and intended rendered placement in development evidence. Do not embed private process text into shipped raster files by default. No external API/tool download, converter install, producer spawn, metadata engine or automatic abandoned-file deletion is required. Actual generated/edited asset work uses the host’s permitted tools and scope.

Return to [new-work.md](new-work.md) for the direction contract, the phased build, and the finishing pass.
